back_content.text: D。under which 相当于 under the conditions，说明志愿者工作的条件。
back_content.explanation: 主句是 The conditions were far from ideal。定语从句修饰 conditions，可还原为 the volunteers worked under the conditions，因此 which 指 conditions，under 保留“在这些条件下”的关系。

analysis_content.text: 主句是 The conditions were far from ideal。定语从句修饰 conditions，可还原为 the volunteers worked under the conditions，因此 which 指 conditions，under 保留“在这些条件下”的关系。
tips: 把 which 换回 the conditions，读出 worked under the conditions。
